Showcasing:

Showcasing is a feature where more tabs can be shown publicly by completing Achievements that are exclusive to the home. Players will only get a certain amount of slots they can show off and they also get a Home Lore slot. In Lore, and on paper (see blue prints below), they can have 20 room Mansion each with a closet, but they only get to show off one type of each thing at a time.  So only one room and it's closest at a time. If they have a Castle, and they possibly can have one, they can show off their armory as their "Room". They can show off one Stable. One Kennel and One Garden etc etc etc. Though in lore they may have more.



"Home" can have various forms, such as; tent, hut, studio, apartment, house, mansion or estate, all either rented or owned.  They can have one various rooms, a small space, 1 room or several, and have features like; "Trophy Room", "Closet", "Stash", ""Safe", Aquarium", "Garden", Farm, Kennel, Stable, etc etc. The



Trophy Room is where Achievements, Trophies, and Collectables (bear skin rugs, shoulder mounts, fish mounts, Rewards and awards Characters have earned from hunting, fishing, collecting , achievements and so forth.  Other things to display in the home are Family and various Companions such as; Pets, Guardians etc.
